met_analysis:
The Low Pressure Area over Northwest-Westcentral Bay of Bengal & adjoining south Odisha-north Andhra Pradesh coasts lies over Coastal areas of south Odisha - north Andhra Pradesh at 1730 hrs IST of today, the 11th September 2026. The associated cyclonic circulation extends upto 9.4 km above mean sea level tilting southwestwards with height. It is likely to become more marked and move west-northwestwards across south Odisha - north Coastal Andhra Pradesh during next 24 hours.
The trough now runs from north Rajasthan to cyclonic circulation associated with the Low Pressure Area over Coastal areas of south Odisha - north Andhra Pradesh across Madhya Pradesh & Chhattisgarh extending upto 3.1 km above mean sea level.
The Monsoon trough at mean sea level now passes through Bikaner, Banasthali Vidyapeeth, Damoh, Mandla, Mana to the centre of Low Pressure Area over Coastal areas of south Odisha - north Andhra Pradesh and thence east southeastwards to Eastcentral Bay of Bengal.
The trough from South Interior Karnataka to Gulf of Mannar across Tamil Nadu at 0.9 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Eastcentral Arabian sea off south Konkan now lies over south Konkan off Eastcentral Arabian sea at 5.8 km above mean sea level.
The Western Disturbance as a cyclonic circulation over north Punjab & neighbourhood persists and now seen between 3.1 & 4.5 km above mean sea level.
